info.name: Agri Stack Composite
info.description:
# Agri Stack Composite: test collection

A bank's view of OpenG2P Agri Stack on registry-test, as requests you can run one by one. It replays OpenG2P's install test (`agri-stack/scripts/test_install.py`) in OpenG2P's reference topology: the **Exchange** (`agrix`: the Composite and its own Commons) and one **department** per registry (`farmer`, `crop`, `livestock`), each with its own Keycloak, Partner Management and Consent Manager.

**Run the folders in order:** 0 Setup → 1 Exchange → 2 Departments release data → 3 Bank onboarding (Exchange) → 4 Farmer profile query → 5 Registries refuse the bank.

| Folder | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| 0 Setup | Loads the signing library (jsrsasign, cdnjs), gets the Exchange's Partner Management staff token, makes the test bank's EC P-256 key the first time |
| 1 Exchange | OpenG2P's Exchange check: Composite ping, use cases, the farmer-profile use case (purpose and scopes per registry), JWKS, internal API not public, Exchange Consent Manager keys, the Composite's key in the Exchange's Partner Management, partner portal and Composite console up |
| 2 Departments release data | In each department's own Partner Management: checks it serves the Composite's key, gives the Composite a scope policy for its registry, approves, waits until served (OpenG2P install step 3) |
| 3 Bank onboarding (Exchange) | Onboards `partner_id` at the Exchange with its key and use-case policy, approves (when `auto_approve=true`), waits until served |
| 4 Farmer profile query | Signed query with the farmer's consent (pass: signed answer, farmer ok), the same query answered from the consent the Exchange Consent Manager stored (lookup), unknown farmer, no consent for another farmer (refused), tampered body (refused) |
| 5 Registries refuse the bank | The bank calls each registry directly: each department must refuse, since only the Composite is its partner |

**Before the first run:**
1. Set the four secret variables `exchange_client_secret`, `farmer_client_secret`, `crop_client_secret` and `livestock_client_secret`. Each is the `client_secret` key of Secret `commons-services-staff-portal` in that organisation's namespace (`agrix`, `farmer`, `crop`, `livestock`).
2. Leave the key variables empty. They are generated on the first run and kept as current values only.

**Changing environment:** every organisation is `<namespace>.{{parent_domain}}`, and each has its own Keycloak and Partner Management URL variables. Registry URLs, controllers, record types and search fields each have their own variable.

**Source:** `environments/test/postman/build.py` in `asmitonweb/oan-helm` (branch `agri-stack-composite`) writes this collection and its environment. Edit the script, not the JSON.

request.description: The Exchange Consent Manager's public keys. Each department's Consent Manager reads them here to accept the consent tokens the Exchange CM issues (issuer agri-stack-exchange-cm).

item.description: OpenG2P install step 3, once per department: each department's Partner Management (its own Keycloak and client) gives the Composite a scope policy for its registry. Until then the registry releases nothing to the Composite.

request.description: Client-credentials token for the Farmer department's Partner Management staff API. farmer_client_secret is a secret environment variable: key client_secret of Secret commons-services-staff-portal in the Farmer department's namespace ({{farmer_namespace}}).

item.name: Farmer department: release data to the Composite

request.description: The Farmer department decides what the Exchange may read: a scope policy for the Composite on data controller {{farmer_controller}} with the use case's scopes and purpose (no partner-signed consents: the Exchange Consent Manager's token is the consent). Skipped when already served.

exec: if (policyOk(served)) { console.log("Farmer department already releases its data to the Composite"); pm.execution.skipRequest(); return; }

policies: [policyInput({ data_controller: v("farmer_controller"), scopes: scopes, partner_consents: false })]

request.description: Polls (wait_attempts x wait_ms) until the scope policy is served.

exec: pm.test("Farmer department releases its data to the Composite", function () { pm.expect(policyOk(served)).to.equal(true); });

item.name: 3 Bank onboarding (Exchange)
item.description: Onboards the test bank in the Exchange's Partner Management: its key and a policy for the use case (name@major). The bank is a partner of the Exchange only; no department knows it. Every write is skipped when Partner Management already has it; with auto_approve=true each request is approved at once.

request.description: Skipped when the partner exists. Raises the onboarding request with the partner's key and its use-case policy, then approves it.
Only when the partner existed and PM does not serve this environment's kid (e.g. a new key).
Adds the use-case policy when the bank lacks it, with partner-signed consents allowed (the bank signs the farmer's consent). Skipped when PM already serves it.

exec: var have = policies.map(function (p) { return p.use_case || ("dc:" + p.data_controller); });
pm.sendRequest({ url: v("exchange_pm_partner_url") + "/policies/" + pm.collectionVariables.get("partner_ref") }, function (err, res) {
if (!missing.length) { console.log("all policies served"); pm.execution.skipRequest(); return; }
return m.indexOf("dc:") === 0 ? policyInput({ data_controller: m.substring(3), scopes: scopes[m.substring(3)] })

item.name: Wait until PM serves key and policies

request.description: Polls (wait_attempts x wait_ms) until the Exchange's Partner Management serves the use-case policy and the bank's kid.

exec: var have = policies.map(function (p) { return p.use_case || ("dc:" + p.data_controller); });
pm.sendRequest({ url: v("exchange_pm_partner_url") + "/keys/" + pm.collectionVariables.get("partner_ref") }, function (err, res) {
var keyOk = !err && res.code === 200 && (res.json().keys || []).some(function (k) { return k.kid === kid; });
console.log("waiting for PM: missing " + missing.join(", ") + (keyOk ? "" : " key " + kid));
pm.test("PM serves the partner's key", function () { pm.expect(keyOk).to.equal(true); });
pm.test("PM serves every policy", function () { pm.expect(missing).to.eql([]); });

item.name: 4 Farmer profile query
item.description: The signed query a bank sends to the Exchange: the Composite has the farmer's consent checked by the Exchange Consent Manager, which gives each registry its own consent token; each department's Consent Manager accepts it. Then the refusals that must happen.

request.description: The partner signs a consent with one grant per registry and the query envelope. Pass = 200, a valid Composite signature, farmer ok, crops and livestock ok or no_record.

exec: var subject = { type: v("subject_type"), value: v("subject_value") };
var header = { version: "1.0.0", message_id: uuid(), message_ts: new Date().toISOString(), action: "query",
var message = { subject: subject, parameters: JSON.parse(v("query_parameters") || "{}") };
// Composite and Consent Manager cache Partner Management answers: retry a refusal for a while after a PM change.
var b = {}; try { b = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
// Right after onboarding, the Composite still holds Partner Management's earlier "no such partner" answer.
pm.test(s + " ok or no_record", function () { pm.expect((sources[s] || {}).status).to.be.oneOf(["ok", "no_record"]); });

request.description: A FAN no registry knows: the mandatory farmer source answers no_record.

request.description: No consent_jws: the Exchange Consent Manager stored the consent sent with 'Query with consent' and finds it for this bank and farmer (OpenG2P's main path, test.consent: lookup). Pass = 200, signed, farmer ok, the stored consent_id.

item.name: 5 Registries refuse the bank
item.description: The bank tries each registry directly (signed DCI envelope, expression query, its own consent). Each department must refuse it: only the Composite is its partner.

request.description: The bank calls the Farmer registry directly, signed, with its own consent, by {{farmer_search_field}}. The bank is a partner of the Exchange only, so the department must refuse: data leaves a department only through the Composite.

exec: var subject = { type: v("subject_type"), value: v("subject_value") };
var ts = new Date().toISOString(), rid = uuid();
var header = { version: "1.0.0", message_id: uuid(), message_ts: ts, action: "search", sender_id: v("partner_id"),
var message = { transaction_id: rid, search_request: [{ reference_id: rid + "-farmer", timestamp: ts, locale: "eng",
search_criteria: { version: "1.0.0", reg_type: v("farmer_reg_type"), reg_record_type: v("farmer_reg_record_type"),
query_type: "expression", query: { type: "expression", value: { expression: { query: q } } },
pagination: { page_size: 20, page_number: 1 }, authorize: { consent_jws: makeConsent(subject) } } }] };
var b = {}; try { b = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test("no records for a bank that is not the department's partner", function () { pm.expect(records.length).to.equal(0); });
pm.test("refused (4xx or not succ)", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code >= 400 || r.status !== "succ").to.equal(true); });
